subject: New job matches for VP Data & Analytics
body:
Hi Ed,

Here are your latest job matches:

---

**VP of Data & Analytics**
TechCorp International
Chicago, IL (Hybrid)

We're looking for a seasoned data leader to build and scale our analytics organization. The ideal candidate will have 10+ years of experience in data leadership, including experience building teams of 20+ people.

Responsibilities:
- Lead a team of 30+ data professionals across analytics, data engineering, and data science
- Own the enterprise data strategy and roadmap
- Drive adoption of modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, Airflow)
- Build ML/AI capabilities for product and operations
- Partner with C-suite on strategic initiatives
- Present data insights and strategy to the board

Requirements:
- 10+ years in data/analytics with 5+ years in leadership
- Experience managing teams of 20+
- Strong background in cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
- Track record of delivering measurable business outcomes
- MBA or advanced degree preferred

Compensation: $280,000 - $340,000 + equity
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid - 3 days/week)

Apply: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/12345?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=alerts

---

**Head of Analytics & Data Science**
InnovateFin Corp
New York, NY (Remote OK)

InnovateFin is a Series C fintech company transforming commercial lending. We need a Head of Analytics to lead our data-driven decision making.

Responsibilities:
- Build and lead a 15-person analytics and data science team
- Develop credit risk models and scoring algorithms
- Create real-time analytics dashboards for executive team
- Establish data governance and quality frameworks
- Drive experimentation culture with A/B testing

Requirements:
- 8+ years in analytics/data science, 3+ years managing teams
- Financial services or fintech experience required
- Python, SQL, and ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow)
- Experience with cloud data platforms
- Strong communication and executive presence

Compensation: $250,000 - $310,000 + equity
Apply: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/67890?utm_source=email
